method: Descriptive source-derived analysis only. All N>1 windows screened by pairwise 5-Hz difference residual at 1e-6 Hz. For 108 nonaligned windows join source-pinned Stage0, Stage1 and Stage2 CSVs plus tiny per-run doppler_sign.mat metadata; use true global reference sign*Stage0 tracking; test makeGrid(-B,+B,50) endpoint rule, final offset phases, true global boundary and Stage1 residual peak boundary signatures. No scoring or held-out-origin inference.

scoring.reason: Stage2 Doppler output comes from data-adaptive iterative local searches with path-specific evolving centers, clipping to signed tracking reference +/- Stage0 bound, and endpoint insertion. Frozen outputs omit per-path/per-iteration centers, candidate vectors, chosen indices/scores and stopping traces. Held-out final-mark phases are outcomes, not permissible exogenous cell definitions.

correction_note: An initial, discarded tally used Stage1 main Doppler as global reference. Corrected result uses the actual frozen-code reference dopplerSignUsed × Stage0 tracking_doppler_hz; see execution record. This did not affect the 108-window pairwise lattice screen.
